h1: Window cleaning in Las Brisas Estates
h1_em: bigger lots, quiet streets, clear glass.
intro: Las Brisas Estates is an estate lot section of Rough Hollow with larger yards and a quieter pace. CleanzATX schedules these visits with room to work all the way around the house.

sections.h2: What Las Brisas Estates is like
paragraphs: Las Brisas Estates is described as a section of larger lots and a quieter pace inside Rough Hollow. Homes start around $1.2M. It is not gated and falls under the Rough Hollow HOA. With more space between houses, the feel is calmer than the busier amenity areas.

Large lots mean the house is often set well back. Walks from truck to windows can be long, and there is plenty of glass on all four sides, from front entry lights to rear sliders. That gives the section a lived in, settled feel.

sections.h2: What Las Brisas windows deal with
paragraphs: Large lawns need a lot of irrigation. The sprinkler heads throw hard water at the walls, and white spots collect along the base of the glass. Bigger yards also hold more trees, so leaves and pollen end up in the tracks and on the screens.

Quieter streets are a plus, but they come with fewer neighbors to keep the dust down. Fine construction dust from newer areas drifts over, and limestone dust settles on dark frames. Pure water leaves none of it behind.

sections.h2: How we work Las Brisas Estates
paragraphs: We budget more time for estate lots and bring enough hose and pole length to stay off flower beds. Access is simple because there is no gate. We can pair window cleaning with a patio hand clean, driveway work on flatwork at $0.18 per sq ft for concrete or $0.25 for pavers, and a house soft wash.

A 4,800 sq ft home is about $480 for exterior windows and takes about four hours outside. Interior glass adds roughly two and a half hours more. For homes this size, a Twice a Year plan saves 10% and a Triannual plan 15%.

why: Plenty of time budgeted for all four sides of a large lot
Flower beds protected, with long hose runs and poles
Pairs window work with driveway and patio cleaning
Quiet streets make for easy truck access

faq.q: Do larger lots cost more to service?
faq.a: Our rates are the same. The total depends on the number of windows or the home's size, not the lot.

faq.q: Can you also wash my driveway?
faq.a: Yes. Concrete is $0.18 per sq ft and pavers $0.25, with a $250 minimum. A surface cleaner handles flatwork, and patios are hand cleaned.

faq.q: Is it okay if my sprinklers run in the morning?
faq.a: Please turn them off before we arrive. Wet ground slows us down and sprinkler water on freshly cleaned glass can leave spots.

faq.q: Do you need me to be present?
faq.a: Not for exterior work, as long as we can reach the property. Interior work needs someone to let us in.

faq.q: Can you clean a pool cage or sunroom?
faq.a: Yes. Sunroom glass is cleaned by hand inside and by pole outside. Tell us what it is made of when you text, so we can plan.
